title: Sharon Place — portfolio as a floor plan
note: The entire homepage is one red-outlined floor plan of a building with 42 numbered rooms, only 9 occupied, plus a DIRECTORY panel and a WHAT'S NEW log. She dropped it twice with Save this. Her steals: a hand-drawn floor plan for her own portfolio, mostly-empty rooms as built-in growth, and the directory so nobody is trapped in the metaphor.
